proposal.summary: Both firmwares register 19 periodic J1939 broadcasts at start-up with scheduleJ1939PeriodicMessage. cm550_runJ1939PeriodicTransmitQueues / cm848_runJ1939PeriodicTransmitQueues call each builder when its 10 ms tick comes (queue 0 is the engine node; queue 1 is the retarder node, gated by datalink_broadcast_enable_flags bit 3). Most builders are also registered as PGN 59904 request responders (CM550 registrar 0x2f47e, CM848 cm848_j1939RegisterPgnHandler). Each builder fills the payload buffer that its initializer gave the j1939_tx_msg_t descriptor and calls cm550_sendCanMessage / cm848_sendJ1939Message. Paired by PGN: five builders are step-for-step twins (EEC1 61444, EEC2 61443, EEC3 65247, EC1 65251, VEP1 65271). Twelve are counterparts whose CM848 version adds fault tests, enable gates or fields (CCVS, ERC1, RC, ET1, EFL/P1, PTO, AMB, IC1, the DM1 task, FD1, EBC1, WFI). Only CM550 sends LFE 65266 and SHUTDN 65252, and only CM848 sends AUXIO1 65241 and Proprietary B 65504. The four CM550 builders with no function row (0x3229a DM1, 0x339fe FD1, 0x32bbc EBC1, 0x34496 WFI) are small bodies that end in rts and are reached only through their schedule pointer.

functions.role: Fills the eight CCVS bytes at 0x801ee2 from the switch bytes, the road speed, the cruise reference speed and the PTO state, then sends PGN 65265.
functions.discriminator: It is the only body that writes 0x801ee3-0x801ee9 and sends j1939_pgn65265_tx_message. Its initializer cm550_initializePgn65265CruiseControlVehicleSpeedHandler only sets the descriptor and byte 1 = 0xf3 and registers this body for request PGN 0xfef1. It handles no received message.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the ECM's CCVS broadcast (PGN 65265 Cruise Control/Vehicle Speed, 8 bytes at 0x801ee2; queue 0 every 100 ms from 70 ms, and the PGN 59904 request responder that cm550_initializePgn65265CruiseControlVehicleSpeedHandler registers). Byte 1 is 0xf3, or 0xf7 when bit 6 of the cruise switch byte 0x80bcd4 is set (SPN 70 parking brake). When 0x803d48 (e2m 1180 +E VSRXRASP) is 1, its SPN 69 two-speed axle field comes from the rear axle ratio switch (bit 2 of 0x80bcd0). Bytes 2-3 are the wheel-based vehicle speed (SPN 84) = the filtered road speed 0x80a9d0, clamped at 156 mph, x 412 / 256, low byte first. Byte 4 holds cruise active, the cruise on switch, brake and clutch (SPN 595-598); byte 5 the set / coast / resume / accelerate switches of 0x80bcd4 (SPN 599-602); byte 6 the set speed from the cruise reference speed 0x80a9c6 (e2m 117D +2 CRRF, SPN 86); byte 7 the PTO state byte 0x80dc2b (e2m 109E +6 PTDXSS, SPN 976) plus cruise state 1 while cruise is active (SPN 527); byte 8 the idle increment / decrement and test switches of 0x80bccf (SPN 968 / 967 / 966). Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65265_tx_message).
functions.evidence: asm 0x31c84-0x31ed0: a3 = 0x801ee2 and a4 = 0x80bcce. 0x31ca2 (0x6,a4)&0x40 gives 0xf7/0xf3 to 0x801ee2. 0x31cca cmpi.w #1,(0x803d48) then andi.b #0xfc/#0xfd from (0x2,a4)&4. 0x31cf4 0x80a9d0 clamp 0x9c00, x412 (shift chain) >>8, move.b to (1,a3)/(2,a3). 0x31d52 0x40 clutch (0x1,a4)&4 / 0x31d76 0x10 brake &8 / 0x31d92 4 for 0x80bcd4&0x10 / 0x31da2 1 for 0x80a9c4==1. 0x31dbe..0x31e10 byte 5 = 0x40 for bit 1, 0x10 for bit 0, 4 for bit 3, 1 for bit 2 (e2m E+6 CRACELSW / CRRESUSW / CRCOASSW / CRSETSW). 0x31e16 0x80a9c6 x412>>8>>8 to (5,a3). 0x31e44 0x20 for cruise active, or.b 0x80dc2b into (6,a3). 0x31e72..0x31eb6 0xd0/0xc0, |0xc4, |0xc1 from 0x80bccf bits 7/6/5 (e2m DSTESWSS / DSDTSWSS / DSICSWSS). 0x31ebc pea 0x801ed4 + jsr 0x104e8. Refs: pea at 0x28c5c (schedule) and 0x31f1e (registrar 0x2f47e, PGN 0xfef1). CM848 0x24178 does it differently: it reports a datalink-sourced switch as 3 (switch_input_datalink_source_bits_cal), gates on cruise_control_enable / power_take_off_enable / two_speed_axle_switch_present_cal / vehicle_speed_sensor_type_cal (0xff / 0xffff forms) and sends no parking brake. So the steps differ: counterpart. Uniqueness checked.

functions.role: Fills EEC1 (torque mode, driver demand and actual percent torque, engine speed) at 0x803492 and sends PGN 61444 every 20 ms.
functions.discriminator: It is the only body that writes the five EEC1 bytes 0x803492-0x803496 and the only one that maps final_fueling_state / the TSC1 control device to SPN 899 torque mode codes 0xf0-0xfe.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the ECM's EEC1 broadcast (PGN 61444, 5 bytes at 0x803492; queue 0 every 20 ms). Byte 1 is the engine torque mode (SPN 899, high nibble 0xf). During a TSC1 override in the TSC1 fueling states 1 / 2 / 20 it is 0xf6 / 0xf5 / 0xf7 for control device 1 / 3 / 2 (transmission / ASR / ABS). Otherwise it comes from final_fueling_state: 0xf1 for the accelerator states (0xfb remote accelerator when the selected alternate throttle priority 0x80aa94 equals 0x8089a4), 0xf3 PTO, 0xf2 cruise, 0xf4 road speed, 0xf0 low speed, 0xf9 high speed governor, 0xfa engine brake, 0xf8 for the derate states, else 0xfe. Byte 2 is the driver demand percent torque + 125 (0x80da18 after cm550_paramSystemModeController, SPN 512); byte 3 is the actual engine percent torque + 125 (0x80da16 after cm550_param_lookup_1, SPN 513; 0xfe while j1939_torque_and_load_not_available_flag is 1); bytes 4-5 are engine_rpm_primary, low byte first (SPN 190). Twin of CM848 0x2588c.
functions.evidence: asm 0x32c76-0x32e06: 0x32c90 tst.w 0x80da50, then states 2/1/20 and indicator 0x80da4e 1/3/2 give 0xf6/0xf5/0xf7. Jump table 0x32d04 (index = state-1, 41 entries): 1 2 3 7 8 30 37 give 0xf1/0xfb (0x32d5c cmp 0x80aa94 vs 0x8089a4), 4 0xf3, 9 0xf2, 10 0xf4, 11 0xf0, 12 0xf9, 24 0xfa, 13-21 28 29 31 33-36 38-41 0xf8, the rest 0xfe. jsr 0xf796, 0x80da18>>8 +0x7d to (1,a3). jsr 0xf8c6, 0x80da16>>8 +0x7d to (2,a3), 0xfe when 0x80d358==1. 0x80ccf6 low/high to (3,a3)/(4,a3). pea 0x80349a. CM848 0x2588c: the same TSC1 part (states 2/1/20, indicators 1/2/3), the same state-to-mode map (1 2 3 7 8 30 37 / 4 / 9 / 10 / 11 / 12 / 24), the same +125 bytes, the 0xfe override and the speed bytes. It differs only in two places: 0xf8 comes from torque_derate_fuel_source_code == final_fueling_state, and there is no 0xfb. Both are the 2nd schedule call (queue 0, 61444, 20, 0). The shared name was verified at stage 9b; it is kept as method versioning of one function.

functions.role: Fills EEC2 (low idle and kickdown switches, accelerator position, percent load, remote accelerator position, bytes 5-8 0xff) at 0x8034aa and sends PGN 61443.
functions.discriminator: It is the only body that writes 0x8034aa-0x8034b1 and sends j1939_pgn61443_tx_message. Its initializer 0x33064 sets the descriptor and registers this body for request PGN 0xf003. It handles no received message.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the ECM's EEC2 broadcast (PGN 61443; data length 5 of the 8-byte buffer 0x8034aa; queue 0 every 50 ms from 10 ms on CM550, every 20 ms on CM848; also the PGN 59904 request responder that the EEC2 initializer registers). Byte 1 is the kickdown field: 0xf4 when the commanded throttle is above the kickdown threshold 0x80818e, else 0xf0; 0xf8 on a throttle fault. To it is added the low idle switch field: 3 while algorithm_enable_flags_13_cal.idle_switch_override_enable is set, 2 on an idle validation switch fault, 1 while accelerator_off_idle is 0 (SPN 558 / 559). Byte 2 is the accelerator pedal position = throttle x 5 / 8 (SPN 91; 0xff while sampled_throttle_override_enable, 0xfe on a throttle fault). Byte 3 is the percent load at current speed from 0x80da1a after cm550_param_lookup_3 (SPN 92; 0xfe while not available). Byte 4 is the remote accelerator position x 5 / 8 (SPN 974; 0xff unless remote_throttle_enable without remote_throttle_override_enable, 0xfe on a remote throttle fault). Bytes 5-8 are 0xff; only byte 5 is sent. Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn61443_tx_message). Twin of CM848 0x25b10.
functions.evidence: asm CM550 0x32e4c-0x33062 vs CM848 0x25b10-0x25d5c, step for step. (1) four throttle fault tests (CM550 status word 0x806008 bits 0x20/8/2/4, each with its 0x806ac4 enable bit; CM848 fault_detected_cal w3 b15 / w4 b4 / w0 b10 / w0 b11) give 0xf8, else throttle (0x80aa82 / 0x40b812) > threshold (0x80818e / ROM 0x5c392) gives 0xf4, else 0xf0. (2) override bit 7 (0x803cae / 0x3fdbce) gives |3, else switch high/low faults (8,0x10 / w4b4,w3b14) give |2, else off-idle word==0 (0x80aa86 / 0x40a57e) gives |1. (3) the same 4 faults give 0xfe, else an override (0x803c9e&0x400 / 0x3fda68&0x2000) gives 0xff, else t>>1 + t>>3. (4) jsr 0xf930 / bl 0x20a58, high byte of 0x80da1a / 0x40ad8e, 0xfe when 0x80d358 / 0x40a336 == 1. (5) !(0x803cb8&0x1000 / 0x3fd5c0&0x1000, the same algorithm_enable_flags_18 bit 12) or the remote override gives 0xff, a remote fault pair gives 0xfe, else remote>>1 + >>3. (6) four 0xff stores to +4..+7. (7) send 0x8034b2 / 0x3fadb0. Both initializers (0x33064 / cm848_initPgn61443Eec2Handler) set length 5, call a stub (0xf99a / cm848_emptyStubFunction7) and register the builder for 0xf003. Both are the 3rd schedule call. Only the fault and override storage differs.

functions.role: Fills EEC3 (nominal friction percent torque, desired operating speed, its asymmetry adjustment) at 0x8034c2 and sends PGN 65247.
functions.discriminator: It is the only body that writes the four bytes 0x8034c2-0x8034c5 and sends j1939_pgn65247_tx_message. Nothing in it touches the VP44: it is a J1939 broadcast.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the ECM's EEC3 broadcast (PGN 65247, 4 bytes at 0x8034c2; queue 0 every 250 ms from 30 ms on CM550, every 50 ms on CM848). It runs the nominal friction calculation 0xf99c and stores the high byte of 0x80da1c plus 125 in byte 1 (SPN 514). Bytes 2-3 are j1939_pgn65247_desired_operating_speed (e2m 10E7 +0 JCEGDSRP), low byte first (SPN 515). Byte 4 is the low byte of 0x808180 (e2m 10E7 +2 JCEGOPRP, SPN 519). Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65247_tx_message). Twin of CM848 0x25de8.
functions.evidence: asm CM550 0x330c4-0x3311e: jsr 0xf99c; move.w 0x80da1c, asr #8, move.b d0,(a3) then addi.b #0x7d,(a3); 0x80817e low/high to (1,a2)/(2,a2); move.b 0x808181,(3,a2); pea 0x8034ca; jsr 0x104e8. CM848 0x25de8-0x25e58: bl 0x20af0 (cm848_calculateNominalFrictionPercentTorque); lhz 0x40ad90 >>8, stb, addi 125, stb again (the same double store); lhz ROM 0x5c382 low/high to +1/+2; lhz 0x5c384 low byte to +3; bl 0x539fc with 0x3fadc8. Identical steps, constants and order. Both are the 4th schedule call (65247, offset 30); only the interval differs (250 / 50).

functions.role: When no transport session is running, it rebuilds the 28-byte EC1 payload and sends PGN 65251.
functions.discriminator: It tests j1939_pgn65251_transmit_status & 0xf0 before it rebuilds through buildPgn65251EngineConfiguration1Payload; it is also the send step of sendPgn65251EngineConfiguration1OnChange.
functions.plate_comment: Sends the EC1 broadcast (PGN 65251 Engine Configuration 1, 28 bytes at 0x8034f2 through the transport protocol; queue 0 every 5000 ms from 110 ms). Only while j1939_pgn65251_transmit_status has no bit of 0xf0 set (no transport session in progress) does it rebuild the payload with buildPgn65251EngineConfiguration1Payload and send j1939_pgn65251_tx_message with cm550_sendCanMessage. It is also the last step of sendPgn65251EngineConfiguration1OnChange. Twin of CM848 0x1b730.
functions.evidence: CM550 0x3366a: status & 0xf0 == 0, then buildPgn65251EngineConfiguration1Payload(0x8034f2) and cm550_sendCanMessage(0x80352a); jsr from 0x33660 (the on-change test) and pea at 0x28cb6 (5th schedule call: 65251, 5000, 110). CM848 0x1b730: the same test, the same two calls, the same schedule. Round 95 twin confirmed.

functions.role: Fills ERC1 (retarder torque mode and enable switch bits, actual retarder percent torque) at 0x80356a and sends PGN 61440 from the retarder node.
functions.discriminator: It is the only body that writes 0x80356a / 0x80356b and sends j1939_pgn61440_tx_message (retarder queue 1). It is no ISR and monitors no duty cycle.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the ERC1 broadcast (PGN 61440, 2 bytes at 0x80356a, from the retarder source address; retarder queue 1 every 100 ms from 50 ms). Byte 1 starts with 0x40 when algorithm_enable_flags_2_cal.j1939_retarder_shift_assist_enable is set (SPN 572) and adds 0x10 when 0x80a9ca (e2m 117D +6 EBSWSS) is not 0 (SPN 571). It then adds the retarder torque mode (SPN 900) from the command source 0x80a9cc (e2m 117D +8 EBCOAG): sources 1 and 4 (J1939, J1939 limit) give 6 / 5 / 7 / 14 for engine_retarder_j1939_control_device 1 / 3 / 2 / other, 2 (cruise) gives 2 and 3 (switch) gives 1. Byte 2 is 0xff when the engine brake driver count 0x8081fe is 0, else 125 minus the high byte of the retarder torque 0x80aa14 after cm550_ioControlBasedFuelCalculator (SPN 520). Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn61440_tx_message).
functions.evidence: asm 0x338ea-0x339ae: 0x803c98&0x1000 gives 0x40/0; tst.w 0x80a9ca gives |0x10; jump table 0x33936 on 0x80a9cc (0 none, 1 and 4 to 0x3394c, 2 |2, 3 |1); device word 0x80a9da 1/3/2 gives |6/|5/|7, else |0xe; tst.w 0x8081fe gives 0xff, else jsr 0xff6c and 125 - (0x80aa14>>8); pea 0x803572. Only ref: pea 0x28ccc (6th schedule call, queue 1, 61440, 100, 50). CM848 0x26238 adds the datalink_broadcast_enable_flags bit 3 gate (0xff), starts from 0xc0/0xd0 (shift assist not available, brake assist from engine_retarder_selection_percent_fault_masked) and skips the mode when the output level is 0. Different steps: counterpart. Name unique.

functions.role: Fills LFE (fuel rate, instantaneous and average fuel economy) at 0x8035b4 and sends PGN 65266.
functions.discriminator: It is the only body that writes 0x8035b4-0x8035b9 and sends j1939_pgn65266_tx_message; the initializer cm550_fuelEconomyPGN_65266_Builder only sets the descriptor.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the LFE broadcast (PGN 65266 Fuel Economy (Liquid), 6 bytes at 0x8035b4; queue 0 every 100 ms from 90 ms; CM848 has no such message and schedules PGN 65241 instead). Bytes 1-2 are the fuel rate 0x80de62 converted by cm550_scaleByRatio (x 0x39c2c3 / 0x3840e, then x 3600 / 1000000) to L/h, capped at 3212, times 20 (SPN 183, 0.05 L/h per bit). Bytes 3-4 and 5-6 are the instantaneous fuel economy 0x804fb0 and the trip average fuel economy 0x804fb2 (e2m 117F +10 TIMP / +12 TIMPT3, 1/256 mpg), each times 8502 / 10000 (SPN 184 / 185, 1/512 km/L) and low byte first. Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65266_tx_message).
functions.evidence: asm 0x33b40-0x33c26: jsr 0x35064 twice (scaleByRatio with 0x39c2c3/0x3840e then 0xe10/0xf4240), cmpi.l #0xc8c clamp, x20 (lsl 2, add, lsl 2); move.b low/high to 0x8035b4/(1,a2). 0x804fb0 and 0x804fb2 each x8502 (shift chain 33,133,1063,4251 x2) then divu.l #10000 to (2,a2)/(3,a2) and (4,a2)/(5,a2); pea 0x8035bc. e2m TIMP / TIMPT3 have scale 0.00390625 mpg, and 1 mpg = 217.7 units of 1/512 km/L, so x 0.8502. Only ref: pea 0x28ce8 (7th schedule call). No CM848 builder for 65266 exists. Name unique.

functions.role: Fills the 19-byte RC payload at 0x803630 and sends PGN 65249 from the retarder node when no transport session is running.
functions.discriminator: It is the only body that writes 0x803630-0x803641 and sends j1939_pgn65249_tx_message; it has nothing to do with VP44 message 0x100.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the RC broadcast (PGN 65249 Retarder Configuration, 19 bytes at 0x803630 through the transport protocol, from the retarder source address; retarder queue 1 every 5000 ms from 301 ms). It runs only while j1939_pgn65249_transmit_status has no 0xf0 bit set. Byte 1 is 3 for two or more engine brake drivers (0x8081fe), else 0x14. Its compare compiles as an assignment that writes 1 to 0x8081fe, so a count of 0 also gives 0x14. Byte 2 is the control method 0xff / 6 / 3 / 2 / 1 for 0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 6 cylinders per driver (0x808200). Then come the five speed points (engine_retarder_configuration_idle_speed, the maximum speed 0x8089ba, points 3 and 4 at 0x8089ae / 0x8089b0, peak torque at 0x8089ac), each low byte first and followed by 125 minus its percent torque, and the reference torque 0x8089a6 in bytes 17-18. Byte 19 (SPN 555) is never written and stays 0xff from cm550_initializePgn65249RetarderConfigurationBuffer.
functions.evidence: asm 0x3407a-0x341e4: 0x803652&0xf0 bne to exit. cmpi.w #1,(0x8081fe) bls, then 0x340b6 move.w #1,(0x8081fe) and beq (never taken), so 0x14; else 3. 0x808200 0/1/2/3/6 gives 0xff/6/3/2/1. Speed words 0x8089aa/0x8089ba/0x8089ae/0x8089b0/0x8089ac to +2/+5/+8/+0xb/+0xe (low byte first). 125 - high byte of 0x8089b2/b4/b6/b8 to +4/+7/+0xa/+0xd. 0x8089a6 to +0x10/+0x11. pea 0x803644. The initializer 0x3422a writes move.b #0xff,(0x12,a0). Only ref: pea 0x28cfe (8th call, queue 1, 5000, 301). CM848 0x26650 tests ==1 (0x14 else 0xff) and also writes percent_torque_at_peak_torque_point_5, so it has one more step and a different byte 1: counterpart.

functions.role: Fills ET1 coolant and fuel temperature (deg C + 40) and oil temperature 0xffff and sends PGN 65262.
functions.discriminator: It writes j1939_pgn65262_engine_coolant_temperature / _fuel_temperature / _engine_oil_temperature with no fault test; it is the only sender of j1939_pgn65262_tx_message.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the ET1 broadcast (PGN 65262, 8 bytes at 0x803560; queue 0 every 1000 ms from 430 ms, and the PGN 59904 request responder that cm550_engineTemperaturePGN_65262_Builder registers). Byte 1 is the coolant temperature and byte 2 vp44_fuel_temperature, both in deg C + 40 clamped 0..250 (SPN 110 / 174). Bytes 3-4 (SPN 175 oil temperature) are 0xffff. Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65262_tx_message).
functions.evidence: Decompile and round 95 rows; pea 0x28d16 (9th call, 1000, 430) and pea 0x338d8 (registrar, 0xfeee). CM848 0x26024 tests the coolant / fuel / oil temperature faults (0xfe) and computes the oil temperature. Different steps: counterpart; the name is right.

functions.role: Fills SHUTDN bytes 1-4 (idle shutdown states, timer function, A/C high pressure fan switch, wait to start lamp) and sends PGN 65252.
functions.discriminator: It is the only reader of idle_shutdown_state that writes 0x8035f6-0x8035f9 and sends j1939_pgn65252_tx_message.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the ECM's SHUTDN broadcast (PGN 65252, 8 bytes at 0x8035f6; queue 0 every 1000 ms from 110 ms, and the PGN 59904 request responder). Byte 1 comes from idle_shutdown_state: RESET 0, COUNT 0x40 (SPN 590 timer active), WARNING 0x44 (plus SPN 594 driver alert), DELAY unchanged, OVERRIDE 0x10 (SPN 592), SHUTDOWN 1 (SPN 593). Byte 2 is 0x7f / 0x3f from algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal.idle_shutdown_enable (SPN 591). Byte 3 is 0xfd / 0xfc from air_conditioner_pressure_switch_state bit 0 (SPN 985). Byte 4 is 0xfd / 0xfc from bit 0 of the lamp command byte 0x80bcf6 (SPN 1081 wait to start lamp). Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65252_tx_message); CM848 only receives PGN 65252.
functions.evidence: asm 0x33d38-0x33df8: jump table 0x33d5a on 0x80d674 (0..5: clr / 0x40 / 0x44 / unchanged / 0x10 / 1); 0x803c9a&2 gives 0x7f/0x3f to (1,a1); 0x80bcd7&1 gives 0xfd/0xfc to (2,a1); 0x80bcf6&1 gives 0xfd/0xfc to (3,a1); pea 0x8035e8. Refs: pea 0x28d30 (10th call) and 0x2f588 (registrar, 0xfee4). CM848 has receivePgn65252ShutdownMessage only. Name right (round 94).

functions.role: Fills the EFL/P1 oil pressure byte and sends PGN 65263.
functions.discriminator: It writes only byte 4, j1939_pgn65263_engine_oil_pressure, and sends j1939_pgn65263_tx_message.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the EFL/P1 broadcast (PGN 65263, 8 bytes at 0x8034e8; queue 0 every 500 ms from 130 ms, and the PGN 59904 request responder). Byte 4 is the engine oil pressure (oil_pressure_sensor_state.filtered_value >> 7) x 6906 / 1000 >> 2 (SPN 100, 4 kPa per bit). The other bytes keep their initializer values: 0xff for bytes 1, 2 and 8 and 0xffff for bytes 5-6. Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65263_tx_message).
functions.evidence: Decompile; pea 0x28d46 (11th call, 500, 130) and 0x2f5a0 (registrar, 0xfeef). CM848 0x25eb4 also sends the fuel delivery pressure (enable bit and faults) and the coolant pressure (enable bit): counterpart, name right (round 95).

functions.role: Fills the PTO set speed and switch bytes and sends PGN 65264.
functions.discriminator: It writes j1939_pgn65264_power_take_off_set_speed and the two switch bytes from power_take_off_switch_state_bits / 0x80bcd0 with no enable gate.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the PTO broadcast (PGN 65264, 8 bytes at 0x803626; queue 0 every 100 ms from 150 ms, and the PGN 59904 request responder). Bytes 4-5 are power_take_off_requested_engine_speed, byte swapped (SPN 187). Byte 6 is 0xcc / 0xdc from the remote PTO switch (bit 4 of 0x80bcd0, SPN 978), plus 1 for the PTO on switch (SPN 980). Byte 7 is 0xcc / 0xdc for resume (SPN 982), plus 1 for set (SPN 984), from power_take_off_switch_state_bits. Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65264_tx_message).
functions.evidence: Decompile; pea 0x28d5c (12th call, 100, 150) and 0x2f5ac (registrar, 0xfef0). CM848 0x2bd58 gates the whole message on power_take_off_enable (0xffff / 0xff) and reports datalink-sourced switches as 0xfc / 3: counterpart, name right (round 95).

functions.role: Fills the AMB barometric pressure byte and sends PGN 65269.
functions.discriminator: It writes only j1939_pgn65269_barometric_pressure (no fault test, no air temperature) and sends j1939_pgn65269_tx_message.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the AMB broadcast (PGN 65269, 8 bytes at 0x801eca; queue 0 every 1000 ms from 170 ms, and the PGN 59904 request responder). Byte 1 is the barometric pressure (ambient_air_pressure_sensor_state.filtered_value x 2) x 6906 / 1000 >> 7 (SPN 108, 0.5 kPa per bit). Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65269_tx_message).
functions.evidence: Decompile; pea 0x28d76 (13th call, 1000, 170) and 0x2f5b8 (registrar, 0xfef5). CM848 0x23e8c adds the pressure fault test (0xfe) and the ambient air temperature word: counterpart, name right.

functions.role: Fills the IC1 boost pressure and intake manifold temperature and sends PGN 65270.
functions.discriminator: It writes j1939_pgn65270_boost_pressure and _intake_manifold_temperature with no fault test.
functions.plate_comment: Builds and sends the IC1 broadcast (PGN 65270, 8 bytes at 0x80360e; queue 0 every 500 ms from 190 ms, and the PGN 59904 request responder). Byte 2 is the boost pressure cm550_scaleByRatio(boost, 6906, 128000) >> 1 (SPN 102, 2 kPa per bit). Byte 3 is the intake manifold temperature in deg C + 40, clamped 0..250 (SPN 105). The other bytes stay 0xff from the initializer. Then cm550_sendCanMessage(j1939_pgn65270_tx_message).

Bits 1-2 are the accelerator interlock switch (SPN 972) from throttle_interlock_switch (switch 26) while accelerator_interlock_enable is set. Byte 5 is the engine retarder selection (SPN 973, 0.4 percent per bit) = engine_retarder_selection_percent x 5 >> 1, 0xff when engine_retarder_switch_level_override is set or bit 3 of datalink_broadcast_enable_flags is clear. Bytes 2-3 = min(road speed 0x80a9d0, 0x9c00) x 412 >> 8, low byte first (SPN 84; Ghidra prints x103>>6). Byte 4: clutch switch 11 -> 0x40, brake switch 12 -> 0x10, cruise on (0x80bcd4 bit 4) -> 4, cruise_control_active_flag = 1 -> 1. Byte 5: accelerate / resume / coast / set from 0x80bcd4 bits 1 / 0 / 3 / 2. Byte 6 = set speed from word 0x80a9c6 (CRRF), km/h. Byte 7 = 0x20 (cruise hold) while active, ORed with the PTO state byte 0x80dc2b (PTDXSS, SPN 976). Byte 8 = 0xc0, | 0x10 test switch 16, | 4 decrement switch 15, | 1 increment switch 14. Sends with cm550_sendCanMessage. It runs every 100 ms from 70 ms on queue 0 and is also the PGN 65265 request responder (0x31ed2 pushes 0x31c84 / 0xfef1 to 0x2f47e). It handles no received message.

Byte 1 = 0xf4 / 0xf0 (kickdown, word 0x80818e JCTHKCTD < commanded_throttle) or 0xf8 on the 4 pedal fault bits (status word 4 bits 5/3/1/2). It then ORs 3 when algorithm_enable_flags_13_cal.idle_switch_override_enable is set, 2 on fault bits 3/4, or 1 when accelerator_off_idle = 0 (SPN 558). Byte 2: the commanded throttle x5/8 (0xff override / 0xfe fault). Byte 3: the percent load high byte (0xfe when not available). Byte 4: the remote throttle x5/8 (0xff / 0xfe). Bytes 5-8: 0xff.
